fusions.name: Far Decree
fusions.desc: Casts a link that deals 36 damage. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Clear the Floor
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Royal Pardon
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Mandate over the Bound
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
